_comment: Display fixes on top of the R2 folder names (cost prices and Chinese notes must never reach the site). Applied by npm run sync:r2 and npm run apply:overrides. Keys are the final product ids; _renames maps the id derived from the R2 folder name to that final id (the old URL redirects in vercel.json).

specs.Features: Sealed body (doors do not open), Front-wheel steering, No suspension on wheels
